package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const diagnosticAssessmentBodyLimit int64 = 128 << 10

type DiagnosticAssessmentHandler struct {
	Assessments studentuc.DiagnosticAssessments
}
type diagnosticAttemptItemProjection struct {
	LessonID        string                     `json:"lesson_id"`
	TaskID          string                     `json:"task_id"`
	TaskVersion     int64                      `json:"task_version"`
	UpdatedAt       time.Time                  `json:"updated_at"`
	LessonOrder     int                        `json:"lesson_order"`
	TaskOrder       int                        `json:"task_order"`
	LearningTargets []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
}
type diagnosticAttemptProjection struct {
	Schema         string                             `json:"schema"`
	ID             string                             `json:"id"`
	PlanID         string                             `json:"plan_id"`
	PlanRevision   int                                `json:"plan_revision"`
	PlanDigest     string                             `json:"plan_digest"`
	TotalItems     int                                `json:"total_items"`
	SubmittedItems int                                `json:"submitted_items"`
	Result         *domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult `json:"result,omitempty"`
	Items          []diagnosticAttemptItemProjection  `json:"items"`
}

// diagnosticTaskProjection is intentionally independent from the ordinary
// task response. Diagnostics need only authored question material; runtime,
// starter, compose, grouping source and scorer fields never cross this boundary.
type diagnosticTaskProjection struct {
	Schema      string                         `json:"schema"`
	ID          string                         `json:"id"`
	LessonID    string                         `json:"lesson_id"`
	Title       string                         `json:"title"`
	Description string                         `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Type        int16                          `json:"type"`
	Tests       []diagnosticTaskTestProjection `json:"tests"`
}
type diagnosticTaskTestProjection struct {
	ID          string                            `json:"id"`
	Kind        string                            `json:"kind,omitempty"`
	Title       string                            `json:"title"`
	Description string                            `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Order       int                               `json:"order"`
	Groups      []diagnosticTaskGroupProjection   `json:"groups,omitempty"`
	Variants    []diagnosticTaskVariantProjection `json:"variants,omitempty"`
}
type diagnosticTaskGroupProjection struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Title string `json:"title"`
	Order int    `json:"order"`
}
type diagnosticTaskVariantProjection struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Text  string `json:"text"`
	Order int    `json:"order"`
}

func diagnosticTaskResponse(task *answeruc.TaskMetadata) diagnosticTaskProjection {
	tests := make([]diagnosticTaskTestProjection, 0, len(task.Tests))
	for _, test := range task.Tests {
		groups := make([]diagnosticTaskGroupProjection, 0, len(test.Groups))
		for _, group := range test.Groups {
			groups = append(groups, diagnosticTaskGroupProjection{ID: group.ID, Title: group.Title, Order: group.Order})
		}
		variants := make([]diagnosticTaskVariantProjection, 0, len(test.Variants))
		for _, variant := range test.Variants {
			variants = append(variants, diagnosticTaskVariantProjection{ID: variant.ID, Text: variant.Text, Order: variant.Order})
		}
		tests = append(tests, diagnosticTaskTestProjection{ID: test.ID, Kind: test.Kind, Title: test.Title, Description: test.Description, Order: test.Order, Groups: groups, Variants: variants})
	}
	return diagnosticTaskProjection{Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-task.v1", ID: task.ID, LessonID: task.LessonID, Title: task.Title, Description: task.Description, Type: task.Type, Tests: tests}
}

func diagnosticProjection(attempt domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt) diagnosticAttemptProjection {
	items := make([]diagnosticAttemptItemProjection, 0, len(attempt.Items))
	for _, item := range attempt.Items {
		items = append(items, diagnosticAttemptItemProjection{item.LessonID, item.TaskID, item.TaskVersion, item.UpdatedAt, item.LessonOrder, item.TaskOrder, item.LearningTargets})
	}
	return diagnosticAttemptProjection{Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-attempt.v1", ID: attempt.ID, PlanID: attempt.PlanID, PlanRevision: attempt.PlanRevision, PlanDigest: attempt.PlanDigest, TotalItems: len(attempt.Items), SubmittedItems: attempt.SubmittedItems, Result: attempt.Result, Items: items}
}

func (handler DiagnosticAssessmentHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	attemptID := chi.URLParam(r, "attemptID")
	if !canonicalDiagnosticHTTPID(attemptID) {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	attempt, err := handler.Assessments.Get(r.Context(), studentID, attemptID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, diagnosticProjection(attempt))
}
func (handler DiagnosticAssessmentHandler) GetCurrent(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	attempt, err := handler.Assessments.GetCurrent(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, diagnosticProjection(attempt))
}
func (handler DiagnosticAssessmentHandler) GetTask(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	attemptID, taskID := chi.URLParam(r, "attemptID"), chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")
	if !canonicalDiagnosticHTTPID(attemptID) || !canonicalDiagnosticHTTPID(taskID) {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	task, err := handler.Assessments.GetTask(r.Context(), studentID, attemptID, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, diagnosticTaskResponse(task))
}
func (handler DiagnosticAssessmentHandler) Submit(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if !canonicalDiagnosticHTTPID(chi.URLParam(r, "attemptID")) || !canonicalDiagnosticHTTPID(chi.URLParam(r, "taskID")) {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	body, err := decodeDiagnosticJSON(r)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	key, hash, ok := diagnosticRequestKey(r, studentID, body)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "invalid idempotency key", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	attempt, _, err := handler.Assessments.Submit(r.Context(), studentuc.SubmitDiagnosticAssessmentInput{StudentID: studentID, AttemptID: chi.URLParam(r, "attemptID"), TaskID: chi.URLParam(r, "taskID"), RequestID: key, RequestHash: hash, Response: body})
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, diagnosticProjection(attempt))
}
func (handler DiagnosticAssessmentHandler) Complete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if !canonicalDiagnosticHTTPID(chi.URLParam(r, "attemptID")) {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	body, err := decodeDiagnosticJSON(r)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(body)) != 2 || string(bytes.TrimSpace(body)) != "{}" {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	key, hash, ok := diagnosticRequestKey(r, studentID, body)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "invalid idempotency key", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, _, err := handler.Assessments.Complete(r.Context(), studentuc.CompleteDiagnosticAssessmentInput{StudentID: studentID, AttemptID: chi.URLParam(r, "attemptID"), RequestID: key, RequestHash: hash})
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}
func decodeDiagnosticJSON(r *http.Request) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || mediaType != "application/json" {
		return nil, errors.New("content type")
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, diagnosticAssessmentBodyLimit+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(body)) > diagnosticAssessmentBodyLimit || !json.Valid(body) {
		return nil, errors.New("body")
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var raw map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err = dec.Decode(&raw); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err = dec.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, errors.New("trailing")
	}
	return body, nil
}
func diagnosticRequestKey(r *http.Request, studentID string, body []byte) (string, string, bool) {
	// Idempotency keys are UUIDs on the wire; surrounding whitespace is not
	// canonical and must not silently alias a different request.
	key := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(key)
	if err != nil || parsed.String() != key || !canonicalDiagnosticHTTPID(studentID) {
		return "", "", false
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(append([]byte(r.Method+":"+studentID+":"+r.URL.Path+":"), body...))
	return key, "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), true
}
func canonicalDiagnosticHTTPID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}
func writeDiagnosticError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrForbidden):
		http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		http.Error(w, "conflict", http.StatusConflict)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		http.Error(w, "invalid request", http.StatusBadRequest)
	default:
		http.Error(w, "diagnostic assessments unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
	}
}
